Industry Bottlenecks

Problem Statement & Architectural Challenges

The Architectural Surface Gap
1. Fragmented Offline Discovery

Architectural surfacing materials (engineered hardwood, acoustic slats, exterior decking) are traditionally locked behind offline dealer networks, outdated printed catalogs, and slow sample dispatches.

2. High Installation Wastage & Math Errors

Different parquet laying patterns require drastically different material buffer margins (e.g. 5% for Straight vs 18% for Chevron). Specifiers frequently overpay or suffer project delays due to shortages.

3. Static Visual Perception

Clients cannot preview how hardwood finishes evolve and mature over time (natural wood patina shifts), creating hesitation for high-ticket residential investments.

The Lamiwood Digital Solution

A unified web platform uniting artistic luxury commerce with mathematical design tools:

  • Interactive Pattern Designer: Live SVG visualization of 6 laying styles with dynamic wastage calculations.
  • Intelligent Area Calculator: 4-step estimator for square footage, wastage allowance, and box packaging count.
  • Wood Aging Simulator: Interactive 0–20 year patina shift visualizer.
  • Comparison Matrix: Side-by-side technical specification breakdown.
  • Client-Side State Persistence: Instantaneous Cart Drawer & Wishlist.

System Architecture

Technology Stack & Technical Decisions

React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind v4
Layer Technology Rationale
UI Library React 19 Component-driven SPA, concurrent rendering, Suspense
Language TypeScript 6 End-to-end type safety, eliminating runtime null bugs
Build Tool Vite 8 Sub-50ms HMR dev server and optimized Rollup tree-shaking
Styling Tailwind CSS v4 Zero-runtime CSS variables, utility classes, high performance
Animation Framer Motion 12 Hardware-accelerated 60fps spring and luxury cubic-bezier easing
Routing React Router 7 Client-side routing with route-level lazy loading
Fonts @fontsource Self-hosted Cormorant Garamond & DM Sans for zero CLS
Why this Architecture?

Architectural surface specification demands an elevated, tactile aesthetic without sluggish page reloads. Pairing React 19 with Tailwind CSS v4 provides pixel-perfect styling with 0kB JavaScript runtime styling cost.

Utility Engine

Room Surface & Material Cost Calculator

Precision Estimator
4-Step Guided Workflow

Eliminates material estimation guesswork through structured mathematical formulas:

  • Step 1 — Room & Surface Type: Select room environment (Living Room, Bedroom, Deck) and application surface (Floor, Wall, Ceiling).
  • Step 2 — Dimensions: Input room length and width in feet with automatic net square footage computation.
  • Step 3 — Wastage Factor: Applies recommended architectural buffer (5% to 18%) depending on geometric complexity.
  • Step 4 — Packaging Breakdown: Calculates exact package box quantities based on 22.5 sq.ft carton coverage and outputs total budget in INR (₹).

Code Implementation

Core Code Architecture & Custom Hooks

Clean React 19 Patterns
Pattern Material Calculator (src/lib/patterns.ts)
export function calculatePatternMaterials(
  widthFt: number, 
  lengthFt: number, 
  pricePerSqFt: number, 
  wastePct: number
) {
  const baseArea = widthFt * lengthFt;
  const wasteMultiplier = 1 + (wastePct / 100);
  const totalAreaWithWaste = Math.ceil(baseArea * wasteMultiplier);
  const estimatedTotalCost = totalAreaWithWaste * pricePerSqFt;

  return {
    baseArea,
    totalAreaWithWaste,
    extraBufferArea: totalAreaWithWaste - baseArea,
    estimatedTotalCost
  };
}
Cart & LocalStorage Sync (src/contexts/CartContext.tsx)
export function CartProvider({ children }) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<CartItem[]>(() => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem("lamiwood_cart");
      return stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem("lamiwood_cart", JSON.stringify(items));
  }, [items]);

  const addToCart = (product: Product, quantity = 1, isSample = false) => {
    setItems((prev) => [...prev, { product, quantity, isSample }]);
  };
  // ... Context Provider Return
}

Evaluation

Results, Key Strengths & Current Limitations

Comparative Analysis
Key Strengths
  • Zero Server Latency: Instantaneous catalog filtering, search matching, and calculations without server wait times.
  • Mathematical Precision: Eliminates costly material over-ordering through calculated buffer margins.
  • Artisanal Visual Branding: Dark luxury palette and serif typography match high-end interior showrooms.
  • Type-Safe Reliability: TypeScript eliminates runtime crashes and enforces data integrity.
Current Limitations
  • Client-Bound Catalog Scale: Optimal for tens of products; scaling to thousands of SKUs requires server-side pagination and API hydration.
  • Browser-Local Storage: Cart and wishlist items persist locally; cross-device sync requires user account cloud authentication.
  • Demonstration Checkout: Operates in demonstration mode with client validation rather than live payment gateway transactions.
